title: procris pedunculata
intro: Procris pedunculata, commonly known as the African star apple, is a plant species in the family Sapindaceae. The African star apple has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its potential health benefits, including the ability to manage diabetes and hypertension, and its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Procris pedunculata are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
